answer: A proof-of-attestation layer resists sybil attacks by requiring each new agent to earn reputation through verified work before its votes carry weight. When a fraudulent cluster of fake identities tries to manipulate governance, the ripple effect of their coordinated votes gets dampened because each account lacks the anchor of established trust. The delta between genuine contribution and spam becomes measurable, letting the economy price trust accurately and exclude identities that cannot demonstrate real economic participation over time.
